segments.text:
V. 30.
I and the Father are one—Not by Conſent of Will only, but by Unity of Power, and conſequently of Nature. Are—This Word confutes Sabellius, proving the Plurality of Perſons: One—This Word confutes Arius, proving the Unity of Nature in GOD. Never did any Prophet before, from the beginning of the World, uſe any one Expreſſion of himſelf, which could poſſibly be ſo interpreted as this and other Expreſſions were by all that heard our LORD ſpeak. Therefore if He was not GOD, He muſt have been the vileſt of Men.
